statement: Median on-demand rental for GB200 across providers is reported at $18.77 per GPU-hour, up about 42% since July 2025 from $13.25, with H200 and B200 medians each up about 11% over the same window.
why: Rental rates for the newest rack-scale systems rising year over year says buyers are competing for scarce current-generation capacity rather than benefiting from the usual price decay.

impact.mechanism: Rising cloud rental clearing prices indicate demand outrunning deployed accelerator capacity, improving economics for rental operators and signalling continued pull on new GPU supply.

evidence.excerpt: The median on-demand price across providers has risen about 42% since July 2025, from $13.25 to $18.77/hr per GPU
the median on-demand price for B200 across providers has risen about 11% since July 2025, from $5.50 to $6.12/hr per GPU
The median on-demand price for H200 across providers has risen about 11% since July 2025, from $3.54 to $3.94/hr per GPU

confidence.basis: Single secondary pricing tracker with no independent corroboration; provider spread is wide and the underlying provider set is not disclosed.

dispersion: GB200 average across providers is $21.53/hr against a low of $10.50/hr, and the quoted range is $10.50 to $27 per GPU-hour.
